status.description: active: in work; paused: on hold; archived: kept for reference, hidden by default in the hub.

defaultVersion.description: Version opened by /p/<slug>/. "latest" = highest version that is not a draft (or the highest at all).

platform.description: mobile: shown in an iPhone mockup in desktop browsers, full-screen without the design's system bars on phones and as an installed web app; desktop: full window (ADR-0020).

platforms.description: Screens the viewer can switch between on a wide screen; the first view is "platform". With both, the menu gets an «Экран» control (Компьютер / Телефон) and the choice goes into the viewer URL as ?screen= (ADR-0025). Without it: only "platform".

menu.description: Viewer menu of this prototype (ADR-0027). versions: false hides the «Версия» control (versions still open from the changelog on main); style: "shadcn" draws the menu as a shadcn DropdownMenu (radio items under group labels) behind an outline button, light or dark after the prototype's own .dark class.

separatePassword.description: Protect this prototype with its own password (Phase 5, ADR-0006).
